usage: 相片 (photo) is a noun used to refer to a picture taken by a camera or phone.
You can use 相片 as the object in a sentence: 我影咗一張相片 (I took a photo).
When you talk about multiple photos, you can say 多張相片 (many photos).
相片 can be used to describe something seen visually, like 電腦入面嘅相片 (photos on the computer).
You can also ask for someone to send or show you a 相片.
